Method of Attack: Deploy second-stage malware on compromised systems for backdoor access, persistence, and data exfiltration
Discoverer: US Cyber Command's Cyber National Mission Force (CNMF)
Impacted Systems: Government and private-sector organizations across telecommunications, defense, local government, oil and natural gas sectors in Asia, Africa, Europe, and North America
Attack Vector: Backdoor access via second-stage malware deployment
